intro: How to recover from stuck agents, wrong edits, and sessions that have gone off the rails.

sections.title: Most Important: Stop Immediately
sections.description: If Claude is doing something wrong, interrupt before it compounds. Then assess the damage.
sections.code:
# Stop generation mid-stream
Ctrl+C

# Check what actually changed before proceeding
git diff
git status

sections.title: Recovering from Wrong Edits
sections.code:
# Discard all uncommitted changes
git checkout .

# Remove untracked files (careful — confirm first)
git clean -fd

# Undo last commit, keep changes staged
git reset HEAD~1

# Undo last commit, discard changes
git reset --hard HEAD~1

items.title: Force a restart
items.body: Say: 'Stop. The approach from the last N messages was wrong because [reason]. Please start from scratch with this understanding: [restate the actual task].'

items.title: Fresh eyes
items.body: 'Pretend you're seeing this codebase for the first time. Read the error message again carefully and describe exactly what it says.'

items.title: Run commands yourself
items.body: Use ! command to run failing commands yourself and paste the real output. Gives Claude ground truth instead of guesses.

sections.title: Diagnostic Commands
sections.description: Run these to give Claude accurate grounding.
sections.code:
! git status             # what's actually changed?
! git diff               # exact diff of all changes
! npm test 2>&1 | tail   # what's actually failing?
! node -e "require('./src/lib/auth')"  # does the module even load?

items.title: Verify after every batch of changes
items.body: Run git diff after each meaningful set of edits — don't let wrong changes accumulate.

items.title: Plan before code
items.body: For complex tasks: 'Don't write any code yet — just tell me your plan.' Catch misunderstandings before they become wrong code.
